headline: WEST RED LAKE GOLD HITS 176 g/t AU OVER 5.3M — HIGH-GRADE AUSTIN PANELS VALIDATED FOR 2027 MADSEN MINE PLAN
snippet: West Red Lake Gold Mines Ltd. (TSXV: WRLG) reported three headline-grade intercepts from the Austin 955 and 904 Complexes at the Madsen Mine in Red Lake, Ontario: 176.04 g/t Au over 5.3 metres, 128.32 g/t Au over 4.5 metres, and 35.72 g/t Au over 13.35 metres, confirming strong grade and continuity across two adjacent mineralized panels. The results directly feed the updated geological model targeted for integration into the Madsen mine plan in 2027 — a pivotal milestone that would convert high-grade drill results into a production schedule at one of Red Lake's most storied underground gold addresses.

headline: NEW PARALLEL STRUCTURE FOUND AT BOUMADINE — AYA HITS 1,038 g/t AgEq OVER 4.2M, MOROCCAN RESOURCE OPEN IN ALL DIRECTIONS
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. (TSX: AYA) announced the identification of a new parallel structure at the Boumadine Project in Morocco alongside infill drilling results including hole BOU-DD26-883, which returned 593 g/t AgEq over 15.2 metres including 1,038 g/t AgEq over 4.2 metres (1.81 g/t Au, 586 g/t Ag, 8.1% Zn, 6.2% Pb), and hole BOU-DD26-848 returning 776 g/t AgEq over 10.0 metres. With 406 holes and 145,719 metres now complete at Boumadine in 2026, the discovery of a parallel mineralized structure beyond the Main Trend materially expands the potential resource footprint at the company's second operating mine project — an increasingly rare multi-mine precious metals platform in a low-risk jurisdiction.

headline: CAMBRIA GOLD HITS 3,383 g/t SILVER AND 166 g/t GOLD AT PREMIER BC — EXPANDED GOLDEN TRIANGLE DRILL PROGRAM LAUNCHED
snippet: Cambria Gold Mines Inc. (TSXV: CAMB) reported a headline intercept of 166.2 g/t Au and 3,383 g/t Ag over 3.1 metres at the Premier Gold Project near Stewart in British Columbia's Golden Triangle, part of a 6,923-metre, 70-hole campaign, and simultaneously announced an expanded drill program on the property. Premier has a storied production history — the Premier and Silbak-Premier Mines produced over 4 million ounces of gold and 65 million ounces of silver historically — and visible silver grades of this magnitude in fresh step-out holes, combined with the expansion announcement, signal management confidence in a significant resource growth story at current gold and silver prices.

headline: GREENLAND MINES ANNOUNCES FIRST S-K 1300 SARFARTOQ RESOURCE — STOCK CRATERS 36% AS DILUTIVE EQUITY RAISE HITS
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd. (OTC: GRML) announced its first SEC S-K 1300–compliant Indicated Mineral Resource at the Sarfartoq Nd-Pr rare earths project in southern Greenland, backed by new drilling and metallurgical work, alongside a pending offtake and acquisition link with Neo Performance Materials — but simultaneously disclosed a dilutive equity raise to fund the Sarfartoq acquisition, sending shares down 36% in premarket trading. This whipsaw follows Monday's +245% surge on the US-Denmark-Greenland security pact, serving as a sharp reminder that geopolitical catalysts in early-stage rare earth projects convert to value only when supported by capital-light economics — the dilution here directly tests how much of Monday's premium was speculative versus fundamentally justified.

headline: KOOTENAY LUPE VEIN HITS 299 g/t Ag OVER 7.6M — 60,000M COLUMBA SILVER PROGRAM PASSES HALFWAY IN MEXICO
snippet: Kootenay Silver Inc. (TSXV: KTN) reported 2026 expansion drilling results from the Lupe Vein at its Columba High-Grade Silver Project in Chihuahua, Mexico, headlined by 7.6 metres averaging 299 g/t Ag alongside 6.28 metres at 274 g/t Ag and a 703 g/t Ag intersection over 1 metre, with the 60,000-metre staged program now past the halfway mark at over 29,700 metres complete. Columba carries a maiden Inferred Resource of 54.1 million ounces at 284 g/t Ag, and consistent step-out hits in the Lupe Vein system at economic grades directly ahead of the next resource update establish a clear resource-growth vector at silver's current $65/oz spot.

headline: KINGSMEN INTERSECTS NEW SILVER STRUCTURE AT LAS COLORADAS — 218 g/t AgEq OVER 6.5M IN MEXICO'S PARRAL DISTRICT
snippet: Kingsmen Resources Ltd. (TSXV: KNG, OTCQB: KNGRF) reported 218 g/t AgEq over 6.45 metres from a new mineralized structure at the Las Coloradas silver project in Mexico's Parral mining district, extending the footprint of the known system beyond previously drilled corridors. The Parral district hosts a string of past-producing high-grade silver mines, and identifying a new structure with 218 g/t AgEq grades at surface in an accessible Mexican silver belt provides meaningful exploration upside to a company with multiple drill targets still untested in the current campaign.

headline: KORYX COMPLETES HAIB PFS DRILL PROGRAM — WIDE NEAR-SURFACE COPPER INTERCEPTS ADVANCE NAMIBIA PROJECT TOWARD FEASIBILITY
snippet: Koryx Copper Inc. (TSXV: KRY) announced the completion of its Pre-Feasibility Study drill program at the Haib Copper Project in southern Namibia, reporting further positive infill results across 18 holes (7,074 metres) with very wide intercepts and higher-grade zones near surface. Haib is one of Africa's largest undeveloped copper porphyry deposits — estimated to contain a significant resource base in a low-risk mining jurisdiction — and the completion of the PFS drill program signals the project is moving into the feasibility workstream at a time when copper's structural supply deficit has made greenfield and brownfield copper projects in Africa increasingly strategic for majors and mid-tiers seeking to replace depleting reserves.

headline: STAKEHOLDER GOLD CONFIRMS BEDROCK AT THREE BALLARAT TARGETS — SEVEN OF NINE YUKON HOLES MINERALIZED IN WHITE GOLD DISTRICT
snippet: Stakeholder Gold Corp. (TSXV: SRC, OTCQB: SKHRF) announced results from nine diamond drill holes testing four large gold-in-soil anomalies at the Ballarat Project in the White Gold District of Yukon, successfully confirming gold-bearing bedrock at the Skye North, East, and NW zones — seven of nine holes intercepting mineralization — with peak grades of 1.20 g/t Au at Skye North, 0.92 g/t Au at the East Zone, and 0.58 g/t Au at NW Zone. The result validates extensive surface gold anomalies across multiple large-scale targets in a district that has hosted significant discoveries, converting geochemical anomalies into drill-defined priority targets warranting systematic follow-up.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,330 AS HORMUZ DIPLOMACY TRIMS OIL — HAWKISH MUSALEM PUSHES BACK ON RATE CUT TIMELINE
snippet: Spot gold held near $4,330–$4,336 per ounce in Tuesday's session, with a firmer US dollar and hawkish Fed commentary from St. Louis Fed President Musalem — who stated further rate hikes are warranted given inflation above target — partially offset by easing oil prices as Hormuz diplomatic progress reduced Middle East risk premiums. Silver traded near $65.27/oz, down 1.11% on the day. Gold's near-term technical range of $4,307 support and $4,398 resistance holds through Thursday's Trump-Xi summit, the week's primary binary for directional commodity moves.

headline: LME COPPER STOCKS FALL 1,625T TO 254,250T — SPOT BACKWARDATION SIGNALS PHYSICAL BUYERS WANT METAL NOW
snippet: LME copper warehouse inventories fell 1,625 metric tonnes on September 22 to 254,250 metric tonnes, while spot copper settled at 671.18 US cents per pound — a premium above the three-month futures price of 669.50 US cents — confirming backwardation that signals genuine near-term physical demand pressure rather than speculative front-running. The structure stands in contrast to COMEX, where over 535,000 tonnes are warehoused due to tariff front-loading; the LME's European tightening reflects real industrial consumption pulling physical metal at spot, reinforcing the thesis that the copper supply deficit is already live in transatlantic markets.
